pages.text: $(thing)Early Blight$() ($(o)Alternaria solani$()), fungus.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() potato, tomato.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() crop residue, airborne spores, rain splash.$(li)$(thing)Favoured by$() 15-32 °C (best 26 °C), humidity above 80%, 6 h of wet leaves.

$(li)$(thing)Survives$() 1 years (residue).$(li)$(thing)Damage:$() up to 30% yield.$(li)$(thing)Control:$() Two-year rotation away from nightshades; Plough under residue; Avoid plant stress (water, nitrogen); Fungicide.
